text:
emma: Rolling v3.4.0 staged rollout now (canary 5% in eu-west-2). Change window 01:00-02:00 UTC. Preflight ok but want ops/ML eyes for first bump.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: preflight checks PASS. Canary allocation created (5%). Routing active.

cho: metrics: https://metrics.internal/redwood/canary/36321  p95 +17% vs baseline, a few high tail outliers around t+90s. no 5xx increase.

sre-oncall: Observed kvcache eviction burst on canary hosts at 01:02. Eviction rate ~3x baseline while mem usage stayed flat.

rafa: Any sign of model-side decode errors or OOMs?

sre-oncall: No OOMs, no decode exceptions. Logs show repeated evict -> miss churn coincident with long sequences. snippet:```
[01:02:03] kvcache: evict key=ctx-6144 shard=2 reason=mem_pressure
[01:02:03] model: req=id=q1a2 seq_len=4096 latency=490ms
[01:02:04] kvcache: miss key=ctx-6144
```

emma: Thanks. Options: 1) proceed and monitor 2) pause increases and pin canary to previous quantized build v3.3.8-quant 3) rollback canary to last GA. I'm inclined to pause and pin to quant for quick stability while we triage.

cho: Vote: hold + pin. Avoid widening. :+1:

rafa: hold. Also recommend capturing a heap/profile sample from canary pod if we pin.

release-manager: If we pin, add a release note: "eu-west-2 canary temporarily pinned to v3.3.8-quant due to KV cache eviction-related latency observed in v3.4.0 canary." Also reminder: change window ends at 02:00 UTC.

emma: @deploy-bot pause percent increases and make the allocation sticky for pinning. @rafa can you flip the pin?

deploy-bot: Deploybot: traffic increase suspended per request.

rafa: Pinning canary allocation canary-eu-west-2-11 -> v3.3.8-quant now...

deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary pinned to v3.3.8-quant (allocation: canary-eu-west-2-11). Audit: deploy-audit/3632101234-pin.

sre-oncall: Monitoring: eviction rate falling back toward baseline within 2m of pin. p95 trending down. Will attach 10m snapshot to the incident ticket.

cho: Adding short RN blurb now and filing INV-2042 for ML/infra triage. RN text: "Temporary pin of eu-west-2 canary to v3.3.8-quant due to elevated KV cache eviction-induced latency on v3.4.0 canary." OK to commit?

emma: OK. Please also add a note to the rollback playbook with the exact pin/unpin steps and the owner.

release-manager: Done: RN updated, rollback playbook annotated, ticket INV-2042 created and triage scheduled.

rafa: I'll collect heap/profile and full request traces for the 5min window around the spike.

sre-oncall: If latency resurges we'll escalate to rollback to v3.3.8 full and open an incident. For now keep this thread open; reconvene in 15m to decide cautious bump vs keep pinned.

emma: Thanks all. Holding at 5% pinned. Re-open thread for reconvene. :slightly_smiling_face:
